title: AgentThreader Manifest v2
description: Declares the set of tasks, their dependencies, timeouts, and verification profiles for a runner invocation.

prompt_ref.description: Relative path or logical reference to the task prompt.

depends_on.description: Upstream task IDs that must be DONE before execution.

verify_profile.description: Name of the project-defined verification profile.

context_refs.description: Shared context references applied to the task.

priority.description: Lower number means earlier scheduling within the same dependency depth.

resource_lock.description: Mutex key. Tasks sharing a resource_lock value serialize on an in-process mutex; tasks with different values (or null) are unconstrained beyond policy.concurrency. Unlike depends_on, resource_lock does NOT propagate state -- a FAILED or BLOCKED predecessor releases its lock so the next holder can run. Use for shared-resource serialization (workdir, file, external system); use depends_on for genuine output dependencies.

metadata.description: Arbitrary task metadata for reporting or filtering.

max_attempts.description: Maximum worker attempts for this task. Defaults to global policy if omitted.
